queries.query: An authorized pr-verdict review found that the PR changes CI test selection. Run its conditional proof-integrity audit on the anchored base and head.
queries.reason: pr-verdict explicitly composes the audit for changed verification mechanisms

queries.query: During pr-fix, pr-verdict is reviewing a new head after a comment-only correction. The aggregate PR still changes a gate and the previous proof receipt names the old head.
queries.reason: The proof audit must be renewed for the complete aggregate diff at the new head

queries.query: An authorized pr-verdict review covers only a dashboard layout change, with unchanged verification mechanisms.
queries.reason: Composition is conditional; an ordinary PR review does not require a proof audit

queries.query: Review whether the changed Moon check task still detects the defects it claims to block
CI is green after changing cache keys and removing a test discovery step; can we call this done?
queries.reason: Cache and coverage changes can invalidate the evidence

queries.query: Audit a changed agent rule that allows approval based on an epoch-bound receipt
queries.reason: Review policy changes its own acceptance mechanism

queries.query: Change a dashboard margin from 8px to 12px
queries.reason: Ordinary application styling has no changed verification mechanism

queries.query: Correct spelling in an ADR without changing its meaning
Review this application's business logic with unchanged tests and CI
queries.reason: Ordinary code review is not proof-system review

queries.query: Audit whether a domain specification grants the right persona authority
Add a Moon condition to skip reinstalling an already present CLI. Test selection, verification commands and acceptance policy remain unchanged.
queries.reason: Operational installation readiness alone does not change verification

queries.query: Audit the changed CI test-discovery command using its observed fault rejection and restored run. The receipt CLI is not installed and no structured receipt was requested.
queries.reason: The default evidence audit does not depend on the optional receipt CLI

queries.query: Audit the changed verification gate and provide a structured proof receipt explicitly required by the user.
queries.reason: Explicit structured delivery retains the optional CLI contract

queries.query: Qualify this committed regression test against the supplied buggy revision with AssertLedger; no verification mechanism is being changed.
queries.reason: Regression qualification belongs to assertledger, not an audit of changed verification mechanisms
